notes:
• Updates now come from Robbie's GitHub (RobbieB1995/framelift-updates).
  Nothing changes for you – the panel still offers new versions on its own.
• New Framelift logo in the Figma plugin and the After Effects panel.
• Quick send: right-click ▸ Plugins ▸ Framelift ▸ Quick send re-sends the
  selection with your last settings – no window. Frames you've sent also get
  a "Send to After Effects" button in Figma's right-hand panel (one click).
• Refreshed installation guide with the new logo and the quick-send steps.
• Fix: gradients on shapes (including fades to transparent) were placed half a
  comp away in After Effects, so a fade could vanish into a hard edge. They now
  sit exactly where Figma has them.
• Fix: bullet and numbered list indents and the gap after the marker now apply
  in After Effects 2024+ (they were silently skipped).
• Second test frame (Figma plugin menu ▸ Create test frame): a pharma-style
  ad with soft blurred shadows, a Multiply overlay, a fade-to-transparent
  gradient, all caps, small caps, superscripts and an ISI tray with bullets
  and a nested numbered list – send it after every update to check.
• The Figma plugin is ready to publish to Figma Community (the live link to
  After Effects on this computer is declared the way Figma requires).
